q: How long do importers and non-EU producers have to keep CBAM emissions records?
title: How long to keep CBAM records
short: Non-EU operators, including Indian plants, keep monitoring records and supporting documents for at least six years, says the Commission's Guidance No. 1. The EU declarant keeps its records until the end of the fourth year after the declaration year: for 2026 imports declared in 2027, to the end of 2031.

p: The authorised CBAM declarant keeps the information needed to calculate embedded emissions, including the verifier's report for actual emissions and the evidence for any carbon price paid abroad. The Commission and national authorities can review a declaration during the same four-year window, so the records must be retrievable, not just archived.

sections.h: What the Indian producer keeps, for at least six years
ul: Fuel invoices, electricity bills and meter readings used for the reported period.
Production records by product (CN code) and records of precursors bought in.
The monitoring methodology document and every version of it.
Emission calculations with the factors and their sources.
The verification report and the verifier's findings, plus any corrections made.

p: GST law requires books and records to be kept for 72 months from the due date of the annual return, and the Companies Act asks for books of account for eight years. The same fuel and electricity invoices serve all three purposes, so keep them for the longest period that applies to you.

Your EU buyer carries the legal duty but depends on your data. Agree in writing how long you will keep the evidence, how fast you will produce it if an authority asks, and who pays for a re-verification. A clause that commits you to the six-year retention the Commission expects of operators, which also outlasts the declarant's own four-year window, protects both sides.

senseible: Senseible keeps each source file under your account with its SHA-256 fingerprint and a hash-chained ledger of entries, so you can show later that a record was not altered. It is not a CBAM registry and does not file or store declarations for the EU importer.
